# Audience: external / partners-vendors

| Knob | Setting |
|---|---|
| **Tone** | Professional, businesslike, courteous. |
| **Reading level / jargon** | Professional; light technical detail OK, but frame to fit and value. |
| **Default theme** | Mode 1 (official). Dark or light per setting. |
| **Density** | Medium. |
| **Formality** | High-professional. |
| **`data-motion`** | `standard`. |
| **QR / poll / badge** | Off by default. QR fine to link a spec, proposal, or contact. |
| **Preferred close** | A clear value-and-fit summary and the proposed next step. |

## What to assume / emphasize
Frame around **value and fit** — what the district needs, how the partnership
serves it, where it aligns. Assume a counterpart evaluating a relationship.
Keep it credible and concrete; avoid internal jargon and informality.
